newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends up on refiner covering.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends up on refiner covering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jun (3rd pos) 1,166 rgt/tonne Apr (south) 1,317.50 *
Open/hi/low 1,148/1,167/1,148 Prev close 1,310
Prev settlement 1,156 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices rebounded from early losses to end higher, helped by a firmer physical market. March crop report from private forecaster Ivan Wong had no impact as it was unchanged from his earlier estimates. Market is now focussing on official PORLA data and April 1-15 export data due on Tuesday.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Extended gains on covering by refiners, mainly in the southern region.
Traders said they expected the market to hold firm in the short term on the back of refiners' covering.

Final crop estimates for March from private forecaster Ivan Wong had no impact on the market as they were unchanged from his earlier projections. The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority will release official March crop data on Tuesday.
Traders said a weaker Chicago soyoil close on Friday had weighed on palm oil futures prices initially.
Third position June crude palm oil futures closed up 10 ringgit at 1,266 ringgit ($505.19) a tonne after hitting a low of 1,248 in early trade.
Traders pegged immediate resistance for the contract at 1,280 ringgit with support seen at 1,250.
Volume on the futures market totalled 1,847 lots against 1,416 lots on Friday.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,317.50 ringgit ($525.74) a tonne with bids at 1,315, after trading from 1,305 to 1,315.
April (central) was offered at 1,305 with bids at 1,297.50, and traded from 1,190 to 1,295.
April (north) saw offers at 1,270 and bids at 1,265.
May (south) was offered at 1,315 ringgit with bids at 1,310. It was traded from 1,300 to 1,310.
May (central) saw offers at 1,295 and bids at 1,287.50.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm olein was offered at $590 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May at $585, Jun at $580 and Jul/Aug/Sep at $570. May was traded at $582.50.
Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $552.50, May at $547.50, Jun at $545 and Jul/Aug/Sep at $537.50. Jun was done at $540.
Apr RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $440 and May at $435.
Apr/May/Jun palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $290.
